nameJa: アイボリー・ペーパーレイヤー
conceptNote: 温かい紙の質感と浅いエンボスで、動画とチャットの図を作る。大きな黒と朱色の文字を主役に、手触りを感じる静かな広告表現。
prompt:
Create a single 1760 pixel wide by1120 pixel tall landscape promotional artwork, aspect11:7 (about1.57:1), like a compact landscape artprint.
Use case: ads-marketing. Chrome Web Store listing tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
Art direction: warm ivory tactile paper layers, subtle embossing, typography-led contemporary editorial graphic design. Calm but confident, sophisticated art-school craft, warm heavyweight uncoated paper with near-black ink and one restrained vermilion-red paper shape. Every texture subtle and physically plausible.
Exact visible copy, each phrase ONLY ONCE: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Fullscreen is one single word. No other text, letter, caption, number or watermark. Set YouTube modestly, then Fullscreen and Live Chat boldly and very large in crisp contemporary sans serif. Make the two headline lines read immediately even when the whole artwork is220x140.
Composition: substantial typographic block across the upper half with7% safe margins. Below it a precise frontal horizontal16:9 video rectangle made from a shallow embossed ivory paper border. Inside the same rectangle: an elegant black paper play triangle at left and a vermilion-red paper-cut speech bubble at right. The bubble contains only three simple ivory horizontal lines and stays entirelyINSIDE the video frame. Four small near-black fullscreen corner marks carefully surround the frame. The whole diagram is one coherent symbol of live chat over fullscreenvideo, not a chat sidebar outside it. Let the diagram occupy the lower half with generous breathing room and no overlap with any letter.
Lighting: soft, almost flat museum lighting revealing tiny paper edges through delicate contact shadows only. Very shallow tactile depth, not clay or plastic3D. Palette warmivory, charcoal and vermilion only.
Avoid humans, gaming, photos, scenes, interfaces, fake chat messages or names, UI cards, chrome, decorative pills, visual clutter, gradients, neon, glow, floating objects, thick3Dtoys, blobs, diagonal perspective, holograms, app-store tropes, extra copy. Keep all content complete within the compact11:7 canvas.
aspectNote: Native output is2.4%from11:7; preserve whole image with uniformcontain rather than stretching/cropping.
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
